First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NWCC Saturday Coffee Ride group ride

An open social ride for members and non-members. All ages and all types of bikes. About 20 miles at around 12 mph, with several places to cut it short. The club points new group riders here first.
